_comment: Published per WP-SCP-022 020H.1 (sub-criterion x of 020H part 3 plan row). The reusable workflow's freshness-warning step compares this manifest at SCP main HEAD against the manifest at the wrapper's SHA pin (in .scp-runtime/version-manifest.json) and emits ::warning:: when the wrapper is more than `freshness_warning_threshold_minor` minor versions behind. Bump `version` + `minor` + `released_at` together on every release. See policies/VERSIONING.md for the semver contract.
